[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] '''Brik''' was a character mentioned in a short story written by an anonymous party that was circulated on the [[Cularin holonet node]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In the story, Brik was referenced as a higher-ranking colleague within the [[Thaereian military]] of the protagonist [[Nightwing]], an enlisted [[Thaereian]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]]. The story referenced Brik's admiration for [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] and his low regard for his subordinates having creased bedsheets.<ref name="the best defense" />
